definitions.explanation: the percentage of households or viewers watching a particular TV program

examples.japanese: {視聴率|しちょうりつ}が{高|たか}い{番組|ばんぐみ}だ。
examples.english: It's a program with high ratings.

examples.japanese: {視聴率|しちょうりつ}が{低迷|ていめい}している。
{平均|へいきん}{視聴率|しちょうりつ}が20%を{超|こ}えた。

notes:
FORMATION:
{視聴|しちょう} (watching and listening) + {率|りつ} (rate, percentage) → viewing rate

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {平均|へいきん}{視聴率|しちょうりつ} (average rating)
- {最高|さいこう}{視聴率|しちょうりつ} (peak rating)
- {世帯|せたい}{視聴率|しちょうりつ} (household rating)
- {個人|こじん}{視聴率|しちょうりつ} (individual rating)
- {視聴率|しちょうりつ}{調査|ちょうさ} (ratings survey)

RELATED WORDS:
- {視聴者|しちょうしゃ} (viewer)
- レーティング (rating - loanword)
- {聴取率|ちょうしゅりつ} (radio listener rating)

TV INDUSTRY:
In Japan, Video Research Ltd. provides the main rating data. A rating of 20% or higher is considered a major success. Prime time is typically 7pm-11pm. Low ratings can lead to early program cancellation ({打|う}ち{切|き}り).
